description: Parse a single-line Python function definition header and report its structure. Each parameter without a type annotation is reported with the dynamic-any placeholder type; a function without a return annotation is reported with the dynamic-any return type. Output reports the function name, then one line per parameter (in order) giving the parameter name and its rendered type, then the rendered return type.

input.text: def g(a: int, b: bool, c: float) -> bool:
